threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You know someone’s new when they still think Hackney is just trendy cafés and boutiques, not a battleground for Tube strike chaos.
Caught the 196 last night, and the driver had a proper chat with an elderly couple about their garden. Never seen that kind of warmth on a night bus before.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a group of kids using the bus shelter as a stage for their breakdancing. That’s when I knew this place has a pulse.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain do you find random techno parties in abandoned buildings, where the sound systems are better than some clubs. Pure Berlin vibes.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only the locals know it’s not a ‘sourdough bread’ but a ‘San Francisco sourdough’—and that’s a big difference when ordering at the bakery.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a tuxedo trying to woo his date on a crowded Muni bus, all while avoiding a skateboarder weaving through passengers. Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think ‘tap a bar’ is all nightlife. In Gràcia, it’s about the quiet corners and street art, not just the bar crawl.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by the way they struggle with tipping—leaving 10 cents on a €5 coffee like it’s an insult.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still wait for the bus at the stop instead of the pub, not realizing the real transport is the conversation inside.
Last night, the N35 had a group of students loudly discussing which fast food joint had the best midnight fries. You could hear the passion!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a couple setting up an impromptu art gallery in a bus stop during the U-Bahn strike, complete with wine and snacks. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a spontaneous late-night karaoke session in a park, complete with a portable speaker and enthusiastic strangers joining in.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they can navigate a Muni delay without breaking stride, while tourists stop at every stop to ask for directions.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy serenading a pigeon on the Civic Center platform today while we all waited for a delayed bus. Only in SF do you get live entertainment with your transit woes.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think we live in the bohemian past; most locals have jobs and complain about the rising rent, just like any other city.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They always stop to take photos of the street art, oblivious to the locals who pass by it daily like it's just another wall.
